summary: Add a versioned, append-only-audited workflow classification overlay for individual documents in completed analysis runs.
decision_refs: FR-CLASS-001 requires users to view and correct classification
The active goal requires better RFI/Submittal/Email adaptability
The current workflow index is explicitly read-only and exposes no correction path
approval_evidence: The approved FR-CLASS-001 acceptance criterion explicitly says users can view and correct classification.
known_limitations: The correction changes only the current run's workflow relationship view; parser summaries, evidence and extracted candidates remain immutable.
Discipline, CSI, system, equipment, area and revision classification correction remain planned.
A correction does not establish approval authority, contractual precedence or semantic relationships.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer file, external provider or paid model is used.
